mapper.select:
select * from ( select ms.ID, ms.MACHINE_CODE, ms.BEAD_CODE, ms.STANDARD_SPEED, ms.QUOTA, ms.QUOTA_MES, ms.REMARK, ms.IS_DELETE, ms.CREATE_BY, ms.CREATE_TIME, ms.UPDATE_BY, ms.UPDATE_TIME, m.machine_name from T_TQ_MACHINE_SPEC_SPEED ms left join T_TQ_MACHINE_INFO m on ms.MACHINE_CODE = m.MACHINE_CODE where ms.IS_DELETE = '0' and m.IS_DELETE = '0'
and INSTR(ms.MACHINE_CODE, #{machineCode}) > 0
and INSTR(ms.BEAD_CODE, #{beadCode}) > 0
order by ms.create_time desc ) t
mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO T_TQ_MACHINE_SPEC_SPEED ( machine_code, bead_code, standard_speed, quota, quota_mes, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark, IS_DELETE ) VALUES
( #{MachineSpecSpeed.machineCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MachineSpecSpeed.beadCode,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{MachineSpecSpeed.standardSpeed,jdbcType=DECIMAL}, #{MachineSpecSpeed.quota,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{MachineSpecSpeed.quotaMes,jdbcType=INTEGER}, #{MachineSpecSpeed.createBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{MachineSpecSpeed.updateBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, NOW(), #{MachineSpecSpeed.remark,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, '0' )
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE standard_speed = VALUES(standard_speed), quota = VALUES(quota), quota_mes = VALUES(quota_mes), update_by = VALUES(create_by), update_time = NOW(), remark = VALUES(remark)
mapper.update: update T_TQ_MACHINE_SPEC_SPEED set IS_DELETE = '1' where IS_DELETE = '0'
